content: Chrome 108+ default interactive-widget is resizes-visual: on-screen keyboard resizes only the visual viewport, so position:fixed bottom bars stay in place and get obscured; old Chrome-Android behavior (both viewports resize) is restorable via interactive-widget=resizes-content in the viewport meta. iOS Safari always resizes only the visual viewport and does NOT support interactive-widget - iOS keyboard handling needs JS (visualViewport/focusin), not meta tags. vh units keep computed values in visual-only mode.
